patches.reason: Two author errors. The start copies a saved punish_* preference only where it is true (if(loadBoolean(key))), so a saved "No" from the advanced setup, which says the preferences are saved for every session, was ignored on later visits: test that a value is saved (!=null). The belt branches test !spanktoy4=="belt", which compares the negated text with "belt" and is always false, so the basket implement was never fetched: test spanktoy4!="belt".

The script is split into section closures (trcode_*) to work around a legacy limit, and each of its 24 endings (23 "The End" buttons after leaving Croft Manor, and the setup's "Quit" for the male-only notice) ends with return "intro" or return null inside its closure, which in Groovy leaves only the closure: play went on with the next section of the interrogation after the ending. A flag set at each ending skips the later sections, and the script then ends as those returns meant. All 24 read as endings (ending text or a Quit choice, then nothing that fits after it); the script's own end is unchanged.
